notes: Hostile source-only audit against data/bill-text/119-HR-1823.txt (Public Law 119-71, full text, 3332 chars). No referencedSources registered. Every substantive prose atom (summary, brief, top_lines, both Section 2 items, underreported, gaps, changes.added, likelihoodReason) SUPPORTED verbatim against source; 0 material errors, 0 omissions - the 2-page study bill is covered in full. All three 30-day clocks (begin review / report to Secretary on completion / Secretary forward to committees) and both time windows (5 calendar years; FY2024 VBA vs FY2025 VHA) are correctly distinguished; discretionary 'may take' remedial actions correctly not overstated to mandatory. 3 minor non-material items: (1) 'President's annual budget'/'annual' glosses 31 USC 1105(a), a cited-but-unfetched statute; (2) sponsor name/party and (3) cosponsor count are congressional structural metadata absent from the bill source (permitted structural facts, recorded UNSUPPORTED only for lack of a bill-text anchor). featured_quotes (Congressional Record floor statement) is not contained in the bill text and no CR source is registered, so it is out of source-only scope and excluded.
